notes.title: The Journey Continues
notes.content:
🌿 Hey everyone!
I wanted to share some updates about the future of the project and a recent milestone. First of all, I hope you're all enjoying the game so far!
If it suits your taste, please consider leaving a review - it really helps a lot.
[hr][/hr]🎉 Milestone Reached
Let’s start with the good news:
The game has officially sold over 300 copies!
That’s a huge achievement for me as a solo NSFW dev, and I’m incredibly grateful for the support.
[hr][/hr]📈 Project Q&A – What’s Next?[hr][/hr]
🕒 How long will it take to complete the full game?

I’d say a realistic estimate is about 2 years or maybe a bit more.
[hr][/hr]
❤️ I can’t progress to Heart 3 with Zelra — is that a bug?

Not a bug! Each “heart” represents a chapter in her story. Chapter 3 is currently in development.
[hr][/hr]
👩‍🦰 Will there be more girls in the game?

Yes! Once Zelra’s final chapter is released, a new girl will be introduced. The full plan is to have 4 girls total.
[hr][/hr]
🔮 Will the other girls have content similar to Zelra’s?

Yes and no. They’ll all have different types of hypnosis, but their kinks will vary to keep things fresh.
For example, Zelra kink content is vore. Each girl will explore something different to keep the content diverse and interesting.
[hr][/hr]
👹 What races will the new monster girls be?

No hard spoilers yet - but here’s a hint: Think about what kind of girls would fit in a hypnosis-themed jungle environment.
Floras, caves, lakes. There’s plenty of potential, to keep the girls diverse.
[hr][/hr]
🤰 Will the game include pregnancy content?

Yes - it will be part of the H-scenes, not a gameplay system.

💵 Will the game price change in the future?

No - the price is final and will not change.
[hr][/hr]
🎮 Will the gameplay change once the new girls are added?

The structure of each girl’s content might be a bit different, but the core gameplay will stay the same.
I want to keep the experience simple and the grind minimal.

notes.title: Monster Girl Jungle Progress
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
The full game release isn’t too far away, so I decided to show off some of the new features that have been added to the game.
Minigame
Once you finish Chapter 1, you'll be able to accept quests.
Currently, these quests only cover the northern part of the jungle - Zelra’s area - since the other girls haven’t been released yet.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531061/db978a2df88a261105115e677c86fd2316f5df7f.png"]

This scene will appear when you press the Summon Bat button (the one that looks like a quest scroll).


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531061/4790102a0091351dc680022dc2b3df964e52dc42.png"]

After accepting a quest in certain places, a new button will appear in the navigation system. If you're not too hungry or it's not too late at night, you'll be able to collect different colored orbs in various areas.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531061/a4e67f774e39784232c12fc4f2fc47ed67793174.png"]

Once you finish the task, you need to summon the bat again to claim your reward. After that, you’ll receive a gift, which you can later offer to your girl.


Interactions
A simple and organized interface for everything you need.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531061/11ab104c970e2d539c17c563574510486f04b4df.png"]

I’d like to start with the right side, which shows a Love Bar. This bar basically shows you the requirements progress for unlocking each chapter:

Chapter 1 = 1 heart

Chapter 2 = 2 hearts

Chapter 3 = 3 hearts

However, Chapter 3 is not finished yet, so your love score will not increase beyond 2 hearts, even if you completeting a chapter is also required for progress.

Now, as for the left side, I’ll keep it short:



Talk Button – First

This is where you can start each chapter or replay them after finishing.



Interaction Button – Second

This includes basic interactions like kissing, headpats, and handholding.
Doing these once per day will earn you some love points, but you can repeat them as much as you like for fun.

She has different reactions to each interaction.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531061/c26f26d611e3c76de890578383be96c7061faad8.png"]


Lewd Button - Third

Synced with the Talk button, this allows you to choose I–II–III numbers, which represent the chapters. All related content is listed there. These are alternative scenes, so they are written differently than in the main story.

Gift Button - Fourth

This is where you can give a gift to the girl.
She has reactions.

Navigation Buttons (Center Bottom)

These are part of the navigation system, allowing you to leave the area or spend the night at Zelra's tree - which, by the way, leads to different scenes.
Important
Chapter 2 will be ready by the planned release date, which is very soon! I hope everyone will enjoy it. Please consider wishlisting the game and leaving a review when it comes out.

That's all I wanted to show for now. See you guys later!

notes.title: New Monster Girl Jungle Demo Release
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The full game isn't released yet, but I've been hard at work updating a lot of core systems. That's why I’ve released a new updated demo, packed with changes. and I’d like to share what I’ve been working on!


New UI Elements and Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531061/18d2bd88748660ff8115be294332335acecfe114.png
Day Phase
The day phase system works similarly to before—you get a limited number of interactions per day before needing to sleep.
What’s new: the day now automatically progresses every 3 minutes (unless the game is paused or you're inactive).

Gift System
This is a new feature that will be usable in Chapter 2. You’ll be able to give gifts to girls to increase your relationship with them.

Food
Instead of using a UI similar to the day phase system, I switched to a simpler and more intuitive design.
Like day progression, your food level will now gradually decrease over time.

Quest
I renamed the quest system to Guide—since it mostly serves to remind or guide players on what to do next.

Settings
Only the UI was updated here. You can still access the settings menu as usual.

Gallery
The gallery has been completely redesigned. Here's a screenshot below to show the new layout!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531061/e94c027c4c3b889598c83ee3758b2788c99fe2fe.png

Minigame

This is new, connected to the Gift system will be only usable after the girls first encounter.
Basically you will summon a bat character and will give you a simple task about collecting orbs, these can be in different colors and different locations.
For now only applies for the North part of the jungle but once the game progressed enough this will bring a bigger area to explore.

Interactions

UI changed as well but it did received a bit of update, the interactions wich does currently nothing will get hidden.


Quick Menu Update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531061/8d5c133c3988a8ce6dcb85ecd6a68ed091dbb373.png
This is the right side of the UI, some people prefer the game without it so from now on you can turn it off in the Settings and turn it back anytime you want.

Sound Improvements

Overall all the sounds were reduced in order to be more balanced between headset and speakers volume.
Basically the game wont be that loud anymore at your own device lowest volume, you can just need to adjust your own speaker or headset instead.

Lovense Support

Yes i indeed added support for Lovense toys, this is mostly thanks to their plugin.
The game should work now with most toys from Lovense. I tried keeping it simple with the commands while setting up different speed for each scene, this might need to be adjusted in the future
with the help of the community.

Writting

Most of the writting got improvements and also changed the story of the player background.


This is all the changes you will be able to see in the Demo build, when the game release come i will reveal new stuffs.
Thank You for the support and hopefully you are going to have a wonderful time during the time you spend in the Monster Girl Jungle.
